gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Uniform, unvarying lines give Grandstander its bold, expressive punch, with letters held open rather than curled shut and ascenders cut short. Noto Sans Tirhuta then reads smoothly, its cut-back terminals leaving generous gaps.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-zanabaz: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square brings wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, with a soaring x-height beneath the bold Grandstander heading. A single-weight outline feel up top meets approachable clarity below.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-parkinsans: Bold, expressive lettering with short ascenders and a generous lowercase. Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk, a quality that holds the pair together.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoine: Audiowide looks like futuristic tiles with wide grout lines. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined gives curve ends generous space from the stem, with little height difference between its cases, a modern, orderly finish.
gen-eater-gf-radio-canada-big: Dark and aggressive, Eater shifts thickness softly and keeps its ascenders short. But Radio Canada Big steps in with monoline curves that don't thin at the shoulders and an x-height filling the line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-preahvihear: Goldman spaces its letters generously, round forms like open parentheses. Preahvihear adds a lofty x-height and an open mouth like a pried oyster shell, and that openness is what the whole pair shares.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-puritan: Constant-width lines with letters held open give Grandstander its bold, expressive look, free of pinched joins. Puritan chimes in with rounded, open-sided forms and oversized counters, giving the text a friendly, approachable feel.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hie: Audiowide delivers futuristic attitude in tile-like letters with wide grout lines. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs does the quieter job, with outward-pointing terminals and an x-height rising close to cap height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-saira: Goldman is bold and commanding, with widely set letters and round forms like open parentheses. Saira meets it with a see-through gap in each s and rounded letters stretching toward the top line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sarpanch: Grandstander is all pipe-cleaner letterforms, bold and expressive, with short ascenders. Sarpanch sits below with a clearly open lowercase e and a compact gap between x-height and ascender line, keeping text approachable.
